name: Jefferson Administration
explanation: Jefferson sought to limit the central government's power, he did this by cutting government spending and he ended the whiskey tax
significance: Jefferson would go on to make the Louisiana Purchase which would significantly increase the size of the US

name: Hamilton Financial Plan
explanation: He wanted a strong central government that would take on all of the debt of the states from the revolutionary war and to collect taxes to pay off this debt.
significance: To do this he established the bank of United States, and in order to get people to agree to this plan he agreed to have the capital in D.C.

name: Louisiana Purchase
explanation: Thomas Jefferson bought 828,000 square miles for 15 million dollars (3 cents per acre)
significance: The Louisiana territory doubled the size of the United States. However people questioned whether it is even constitutional for the president to buy land on behalf of the United States.

name: Madison Administration
explanation: He was the fourth president of the United States.
significance: He was president durning the war of 1812.

name: War of 1812
explanation: The United States goes to war with Canada/Britain and it results in a stalemate.
significance: The United States gains nationalism, the respect of other nations, a canadian boarder. Andrew Jackson becomes a war hero. The federalist party was weakened and US industry is improved.

name: Canadian Invasions
explanation: The United States tried to invade Canada 3 times and failed.
significance: The reason that the US failed is because they did not have the money they needed, because the charter for the US bank was going to expire.

name: Chesapeake Campaign
explanation: The British send an invasion into the United states that marches down to D.C.
significance: Canada burns down the White House.

name: Fort McHenry & Star Spangled Banner Written
explanation: The United States and the British reach a stalemate at Fort McHenry.
significance: The morning after watching the battle Francis Scott Key writes the "Star Spangled Banner"

name: Treaty of Ghent
explanation: The Treaty of Ghent ended the War of 1812.
significance: The Americans and the british realized that the war was going nowhere and that it would be tetter to just go back to how things were before the war.

name: Battle of New Orleans
explanation: Andrew Jackson Defeats a Major british ally in Alabama.
significance: This Battle would cause Andrew Jackson to become a war hero, despite the battle taking place after the war was over but before the soldiers knew the war was over.

name: Monroe Administration
explanation: It was known as "The Era of Good Feelings"
significance: The Federalist party was gone leaving only the Democratic-Republicans. He also signed the Missouri Compromise. He is also responsible for issuing the Monroe Doctrine

name: Marbury v. Madison
explanation: Marbury v. Madison was responsible for establishing judicial review.
significance: It strengthened the federal government.

name: McCulloch v. Maryland
explanation: Maryland was trying to tax the federal bank because it was within Maryland, but the supreme court rule that states could not tax federal entities.
significance: It lead to the "Elastic Clause" which stated that the federal government has implied powers

name: Henry Clay's "American System"
explanation: The "American System" was a plane for the United States' economy.
significance: It contained three parts: protect domestic production by banning trade with Britain and France, Create a new bank of the United States to regulate money, and build more infrastructure

name: Monroe Doctrine
explanation: President Monroe Stated to the world but mostly targeted a europe to stay out of the Americas
significance: It established The United States as the Predominant Power in the Americas

name: First Industrial Revolution
explanation: The Erie Canal opens in 1825, Robert Fulton invents the Steam boat in 1807, and Samuel Slater develops the "Factory"
significance: Products got cheaper and easier to ship at the cost of the moral problems of things like poor working conditions and child labor. It also lead to the growth of cites as more people moved toward factory jobs.

name: Jackson Administration
explanation: At first he lost to John Q. Adams in the election of 1824 but then wins in 1828.
significance: He utilized a system know as the "spoils system" in which jackson gave people who supported him government positions. Jackson was considered to be a man for the "common men" and removed the property owning requirement from voting rights.

name: Nullification Crisis
explanation: South Carolina did not want to pay the tariffs that Andrew Jackson wanted to enforce.
significance: Andrew Jackson enacts the Force Bill to send troops to enforce the tariff resulting in South Carolina retracting their claims about nullification

name: Indian Removal Act of 1830
explanation: Andrew Jackson Forces Native Americans to move to Oklahoma against their will in an event known as the "Trail of Tears" in which over 4000 die.
significance: This happens after the supreme court rules removing the native americans from their land to be unconstitutional and Jackson does it anyway

name: Texas War
explanation: American settlers begin to farm in Texas. Then in 1834, Antonio López de Santa Anna decided that he would be dictator of Texas. this makes Mexico unhappy as the believed that the US was trying to take Texas from them.
significance: The Battle at the Alamo results in the phrase "Remember the Alamo" and Mexican resentment towards the United States

name: Polk Administration
explanation: He was the Eleventh president of the United States
significance: Polk Favored the annexation of Texas and the occupation of Oregon

name: Annexation of Texas
explanation: in 1845 under the presidency of Polk, the US Congress Annexes Texas.
significance: This Results in a war with Mexico, Because Polk moved troops to texas to which they were attacked by mexican soldiers who did not consider the Annexation to be legitimate resulting in the troops having shed "American blood on American soil".

name: War with Mexico
explanation: The United States goes to war with Mexico after annexing Texas
significance: This war results in the "Mexican Cession" (1848) in which the United States pays 15 million dollars for the territory that would become California, New Mexico, Arizona, Colorado, Wyoming, Utah, and Nevada.

name: Seneca Falls
explanation: Elizabeth Cady Stanton was a women's rights activist and in 1848 she organized the Seneca Falls Conference
significance: This event marked the beginning of organized activism for women's rights
